plugin: Here There Be Monsters - Curse of Cipactli.esp
rule: Stand-ins for the cell's missing pieces. Every missing piece comes from Dragonborn.esm, which the project does not use. One is known by its use: the table with eight pieces set on it, 0.88 m above the floor. A table of the same kind and height, with its pivot at the base, takes its place. The rest are listed as gaps.

substitutions.why: A table stood here; a square plank table takes its place.

gaps.search: Dragonborn.esm is not in the vault (skyrim-source/Data holds Skyrim.esm and Update.esm only) and the owner excludes Dragonborn content (CLAUDE.md asset rule), so the base cannot be resolved to an object; a UESP search for the form id found no page (16k walk 7, places lane, 2026-10-01). With the object unknown, no same-object stand-in (R48) can be chosen.
gaps.why: A small household object from Dragonborn stood here. Its record is not in the vault, so the spot stays bare.
